name: Tuni Textile Mills Limited
about: Tuni Textile Mills Limited manufactures and sells synthetic, blended, and cotton fabrics for the apparel industry in India. The company offers uniform, shirting, suiting, and trouser fabrics made from polyester, polyester-cotton, polyester-viscose, cotton-linen, and various other blends. It also provides grey fabrics, such as cotton and cotton mixture fabrics. In addition, the company trades in yarns. The company serves brands and companies, wholesalers, exporters, uniform-fabric makers, and multinational companies. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Mumbai, India.
